name: What is the typical timeline for a luxury home design and construction project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a luxury home design and construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a luxury home design and construction project can vary significantly based on complexity, size, and customization. Generally, the design phase can take 3-6 months, while the construction phase might range from 12-24 months or more. Factors such as securing permits, material procurement, and client revisions can influence the overall duration. Opus Builders works to establish a realistic schedule upfront and keeps clients informed throughout each stage, aiming for efficient project completion without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury home projects typically take 3-6 months for design and 12-24+ months for construction, depending on complexity and customization.
